scoring_dimensions.reasoning: High criticality: core financial system with regulatory implications
AIX 7.2 is EOL; COBOL is a deeply legacy language with vanishing expertise pool
1-Tier monolithic architecture; deeply coupled; no CI/CD; no containerization
Confidential data classification; financial transactions; regulatory reporting
5 external interfaces; no REST APIs (0 endpoints); batch-style integration
2 servers, 1 TB DB; on-premise deployment with proprietary AIX OS

key_risk_factors: COBOL programming language — extreme specialist skill scarcity
AIX 7.2 operating system EOL — requires specialized IBM hardware/expertise
1-Tier monolithic architecture — no separation of concerns
No CI/CD pipeline — manual deployments increase risk
No API endpoints — tightly batch-oriented integration
Planned decommission in 2027 — must plan migration path urgently
modernization_recommendation: High urgency. Plan OS migration from AIX to Linux, and data/logic migration pathway away from COBOL before the 2027 decommission deadline. Oracle 19c is still supported and can be the anchor for data migration.
